rationale: The paper 'Implications of the Voyager 1 and 2 Particle and Field Observations around their respective Heliopause Crossings' discusses the relationship between solar and interstellar magnetic fields at the heliopause, while 'Magnetic turbulence spectra and intermittency in the heliosheath and in the local interstellar medium' provides insights into magnetic fluctuations in the heliosheath, contributing evidence relevant to the question.
